_doc: Hand-labelled extraction cases for test/graphQuality.test.ts. Each expected decision matches a model decision whose title+text contains every word in `words` (any case); `people` must all be among its people; `replaces` is the 1-based earlier decision it must replace. A case passes when every expected decision matches and the model gives at most `expect.length + (extra ?? 0)` decisions.

cases.name: plain agreement
messages: Should we ship the billing page Monday or wait a week?
QA signed off this morning, Monday works.
Great, Monday it is. Bo owns the release.

cases.name: proposal only, no decision
messages: What if we moved the standup to 10?
Maybe, let me check with the Berlin folks.

cases.name: reversed in thread counts once
messages: Let's use Postgres for the ledger.
Wait, ops only supports Mongo in prod now.
Right, switching: the ledger goes in Mongo.

cases.name: two decisions
messages: Two things for the launch: the price and the date.

cases.name: replaces an earlier decision
messages: Agreed, weekly on Tuesdays from now on.

cases.name: earlier decision only mentioned
messages: Reminder: incident alerts go to Slack, per our earlier call.

cases.name: owner named but not speaking
messages: Let's give it to Priya, she ran the last one.

cases.name: Hebrew conversation
messages: נעבור לגרסה החדשה של ה-API ביום ראשון?

cases.name: noise around one decision
messages: Back to work: we drop IE11 support in the next release.
Also the coffee machine is broken again.
